subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: live Library persistence PASS; pathname create-if-absent/CAS FAIL
body: Live backend exercise at current main 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1: append-only Library upload PASS and immediate readback PASS. A second different payload intentionally requested the identical destination path with overwrite=false; the backend accepted it and assigned duplicate-safe name LIBRARY_CREATE_ONCE_PROBE(1).json instead of rejecting the conflicting write. Therefore this Library surface is suitable for durable append-only evidence but pathname exclusivity cannot implement PrimarySingletonLease acquisition. This materially closes the prior 'no live forum write adapter exercised' gap for this runtime while confirming the shadow trial's production-CAS/fencing gap. Cycle 2 will specify/test fail-closed fence and verified BackupReceipt semantics. No production Git writes.
